exception.reason: All four degrees apply biology to oral disease from the first year and progress to oral diagnosis and treatment. The Groningen plan develops physiology, immunity, pathology, psychology and population health but never returns to the mouth or dentition as a sustained taught subject. Its advanced courses cannot support the claimed closest match.
exception.curriculumContext: The 2026–2027 regulations set out a Dutch-taught, three-year curriculum of 60 EC per year, with no tracks, minor or elective space. The assessment plan details the supervised bachelor thesis and patient care in the Bachelor Clinic.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Functional Anatomy and Human Physiology teach general bodily structure and function. Infection & Immunity, Pharmacology and Molecular Pathology develop mechanisms of illness. Epidemiology & Public Health and Medical & Health Psychology address prevention and patient behaviour. The approved 24-course plan and the ACTA biomedical, prevention and materials alternatives were challenged against Groningen's required oral-disease courses, restoration and bachelor clinic. Advanced UCR teaching does not study oral pathophysiology, prevention of dental disease, or restorative assessment. The absence of dental licensing is incidental to this academic finding.

audience.programmeDescription: Dentistry at the University of Groningen combines human and oral science with technical skills and patient care. Students practise on artificial jaws and teeth, progress to supervised care and complete a bachelor thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in disease mechanisms, immunity, prevention and health behaviour. Groningen develops those foundations into the diagnosis and treatment of oral disease through preclinical work and patient care.
